title: Which station NOx analyzers' converters go on the regional laboratory's January 2028 bench, the ones whose efficiency would be below 95 per cent before the analyzer's scheduled 2028 service, beside each station's 2027 NO2 record (valid hours, annual mean, 19th highest hourly value)

sources.origin: generated by task251/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional air quality agency of the lower Po valley: sixteen stations, each with a chemiluminescence NOx analyzer whose molybdenum converter loses efficiency with the NO2 it reduces along a curve that steepens near exhaustion, an hourly NO2 field with the valley's winter inversions, quarterly gas-phase titrations by two calibration contractors in their own formats, converter changes at scheduled services and after failed titrations, a store spare standing in during repairs, new data loggers, the analyzers' own hourly archive and the network's validated database; the agency, the laboratory, the contractors, the stations and every person are invented, the practice follows UNI EN 14211 and published practice for chemiluminescence analyzers, and no real dataset is reproduced.
